summary: Palmer Square Capital BDC Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose management's unaudited estimate of net asset value per share as of April 30, 2026, which was $13.59. This is a routine NAV update for a BDC, not a special situation event. There are no terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics related to any transaction. No deal, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special situation is described. The filing is a periodic informational update with no event-driven implications for special-situations classification.
